- [ASSISTANT_SAID] King worked to raise awareness about poverty and economic inequality and spoke out against the Vietnam War.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] King's work contributed to the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and the Voting Rights Act of 1965.
